title: Medial prefrontal cortex input to lateral entorhinal cortex supports both encoding and retrieval of associative recognition memory
authors: Kinnavane L; Barker GR; Banks PJ; Bashir ZI; Warburton EC
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大脑前额叶-内嗅皮层回路对联想识别记忆的编码与提取，属神经科学记忆机制，与蛋白质-DNA互作及AI/物理模拟方法完全无关。
abstract: Associative recognition memory allows us to form representations of items and their environment and to judge the novelty of such representations. This memory is dependent on a brain circuit that includes interactions between medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) and lateral entorhinal cortex (LEC); however it is unknown whether the interaction of these brain areas is required for memory encoding, retrieval or both processes. Furthermore, little is known as to whether indirect or direct mPFC-LEC connections are critical for associative recognition memory and, if the latter, in which direction information travels. To address these questions, we first performed pharmacological disconnection of mPFC and LEC, finding that mPFC-LEC interaction is required for both memory encoding and retrieval. Next, we optogenetically inhibited projections from mPFC to LEC, showing that this projection was crucial for both encoding and retrieval of both object-in-place and object-in-context recognition memory when a 1 h, but not a 5 min, memory retention delay was used. These data show that a direct connection from mPFC to LEC is critical for associative recognition memory, in a delay-dependent manner.
abstract_zh: 联想识别记忆使我们能够形成项目及其环境的表征，并判断此类表征的新颖性。这种记忆依赖于一个包括内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC）和外侧内嗅皮层（LEC）之间相互作用的脑回路；然而，尚不清楚这些脑区的相互作用是否对记忆编码、提取或这两个过程都是必需的。此外，关于间接或直接的mPFC-LEC连接对联想识别记忆是否关键，以及如果是后者，信息传递的方向如何，目前知之甚少。为解决这些问题，我们首先进行了mPFC和LEC的药理学失连接，发现mPFC-LEC相互作用对记忆编码和提取都是必需的。接下来，我们通过光遗传学抑制了从mPFC到LEC的投射，结果显示，当使用1小时而非5分钟的记忆保持延迟时，这一投射对物体位置和物体情境识别记忆的编码和提取均至关重要。这些数据表明，从mPFC到LEC的直接连接对联想识别记忆至关重要，且其作用具有延迟依赖性。
